transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've completely lost interest in all the things I used to enjoy, and I feel constantly drained of energy. This deep sense of depression and exhaustion has been going on for about a year and ten months now.
Have there been any periods during the past year and ten months when you felt back to your usual self for more than two months at a time?
No, I haven't had any periods where I felt back to my usual self. It has been completely continuous and ongoing for the entire year and ten months. I haven't had a single break from feeling this way.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Major Depressive Disorder, Persistent Depressive Disorder], but the patient reports a continuous depressed mood/anhedonia and low energy for 1 year and 10 months with no symptom-free interval longer than 2 months. This chronic, unremitting course makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely as the primary diagnosis and strongly favors Persistent Depressive Disorder.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a chronically depressed mood/anhedonia with low energy lasting 1 year and 10 months, with no symptom-free period longer than two months, which fits Persistent Depressive Disorder. The continuous, long-duration course argues against Major Depressive Disorder alone, and the chronicity is far beyond what would be expected for Adjustment Disorder.
